name: Enable Windows Game Mode
description: Enables Windows Game Mode to prioritize game processes and reduce background interruptions while playing.

description_i18n.en: Enables Windows Game Mode to prioritize game processes and reduce background interruptions while playing.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert den Windows-Spielmodus, um Spiele zu priorisieren und Hintergrundunterbrechungen während des Spielens zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Active le mode Jeu de Windows afin d'aider à prioriser les jeux et à réduire les interruptions en arrière-plan pendant le jeu.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies registry values AllowAutoGameMode and AutoGameModeEnabled under HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar to enable or disable the feature
